title: 第21章 结婴剑斩秦问天第22章 万兽宗来人温玉颜的白虎
content_zh:
（）;
read2（）;秦问天的目光落在那抹倔强挺立的紫色身影上，目光里满是戏谑来。
“碍事的畜生解决了，现在该好好品尝你了，美人儿。”
“太阴斩！”
子书禾清叱一声，根本不愿与他废话。
秦问天嘴角勾起一抹嘲弄，身形竟在原地模糊了一下。
下一个刹那，他如同鬼魅般出现在左侧三丈之外。
“速度太慢了，燃烧精血换来这点力量？”
子书禾银牙紧咬，眼中怒火更盛。
她双臂一展，雪白长发无风自动，更多的天地阴气被强行攫取而来，在她掌心又凝聚成一柄长剑。
“斩！”
她身化流光，双剑舞动间，漫天皆是清冷皎洁的剑影。
每一剑都指向秦问天的要害，剑势连绵不绝。
秦问天不闪不避，只是随意抬起右手，食指与中指并拢，指尖泛起浓郁的金芒。
他就这样信手点出，迎向子书禾那疾风暴雨般的剑影。
叮叮叮叮……
密集如雨打芭蕉般的脆响炸开，秦问天仅凭两根手指，竟将子书禾的双剑攻势尽数接下。
紧接着，他以指作剑，骤然挥出一剑。
嗤啦——
裂帛之声清脆响起，子书禾左肩至手臂处的紫色裙衫应声破裂，一道尺许长的口子绽开，露出下方欺霜赛雪的肌肤。

一道浅浅的红痕随即在那雪肤上浮现，渗出细密的血珠，如同雪地红梅，刺痛而妖艳。
“嗯，肌肤胜雪，滑不留手。”
秦问天深深吸了一口气，仿佛在嗅那伤口散出的血腥与女子体香混合的味道，脸上露出陶醉的神情。
“这一指，老夫只用了半分力。”
子书禾闷哼一声，用手捂住破裂的衣衫，遮住外露的春光，眼中几乎要喷出火来。
“无耻老贼！”
“无耻？待会儿还有更无耻的。”
秦问天哈哈大笑，身形再动。
他如同跗骨之蛆，紧紧贴着子书禾，却并不下重手，只是不断攻击着子书禾的衣裙。
“怎么，没力气了？”
秦问天站在不远处，好整以暇地欣赏着自己的杰作，目光贪婪地舔舐过子书禾每一寸暴露的肌肤。
“是不是等着你那在宝库里躲着的夫君来救你？
可惜啊，等他出来，看到的只怕是你在我身下婉转承欢的模样，或者是一具还能供老夫玩弄的温热尸体。
你说，他会不会因此心神失守，走火入魔，哈哈哈……”
“你……做梦！”
子书禾声音嘶哑，她强提最后灵力，将长剑掷向秦问天面门。
“困兽犹斗。”
秦问天冷笑，随意挥袖击飞长剑，而后一掌轰出。
砰！
子书禾倒飞而出，在空中划出一道凄艳的弧线，然后重重砸进了后方一处残破的院墙之中。

轰隆！
碎石砖瓦滚落，烟尘弥漫。
子书禾躺在废墟里，只觉得全身骨骼都像散了架，剧痛如潮水般袭来。

read2(); Qin Wentian's eyes fell on the stubborn purple figure, his eyes full of teasing.
"The troublesome beast has been dealt with. Now it's time to taste you, my beauty."
"Taiyin Slash!"
Zishu Heqing scolded, unwilling to talk nonsense with him at all.
The corner of Qin Wentian's mouth curled up with a hint of mockery, and his figure blurred in place.
The next moment, he appeared three feet away on the left like a ghost.
"The speed is too slow. Burning blood and essence in exchange for this little power?"
Zi Shuhe gritted his silver teeth and his eyes became more angry.
She stretched out her arms, and her long snow-white hair moved automatically. More Yin Qi from heaven and earth was forcibly captured, and condensed into a long sword in her palm.
"Cut!"
She transformed into a stream of light, and as her swords danced, the sky was filled with cold and bright sword shadows.
Each sword was pointed at Qin Wentian's vital point, and the sword force was continuous.
Qin Wentian did not dodge or dodge, he just raised his right hand casually, his index finger and middle finger together, and the fingertips glowed with a rich golden light.
He just pointed it out casually, facing Zi Shuhe's sword shadow like a storm.
Ding ding ding ding…
There were loud explosions like rain hitting plantains, and Qin Wentian managed to catch all of Zi Shuhe's double-sword attacks with just two fingers.
Then, he used his fingers as a sword and suddenly swung the sword.
Tsk-
The sound of tearing silk was heard clearly, and Zi Shuhe's purple dress from her left shoulder to her arms tore apart, and a foot-long gash opened, revealing the frosty and snowy skin underneath.
A shallow red mark immediately appeared on the snowy skin, oozing out fine drops of blood, like red plums in the snow, stinging and alluring.
"Well, my skin is better than snow, and I can't keep my hands from slipping."
Qin Wentian took a deep breath, as if smelling the smell of blood mixed with the woman's body fragrance from the wound, with an intoxicated look on his face.
"This finger, I only used half of my strength."
Zi Shuhe groaned, covering his torn clothes with his hands to cover the exposed spring light, his eyes almost bursting with fire.
"Shameless old thief!"
"Shameless? There will be something even more shameless later."
Qin Wentian laughed loudly and moved again.
He was like a tarsal maggot, clinging to Zi Shuhe, but he didn't hit hard, he just kept attacking Zi Shuhe's clothes.
"What, no more energy?"
Qin Wentian stood not far away, taking his time to admire his masterpiece, his eyes greedily licking every inch of Zi Shuhe's exposed skin.
“Are you waiting for your husband who is hiding in the treasure house to rescue you?
What a pity, when he comes out, all he will see is your graceful and joyful appearance under me, or a warm corpse that I can still play with.
Do you think he will lose his mind and become possessed by this? Hahaha..."
"You...are dreaming!"
Zi Shuhe's voice was hoarse. She forced out the last of her spiritual power and threw the long sword towards Qin Wentian's face.
"The trapped beast still fights."
Qin Wentian sneered, waved his sleeve to knock the sword away, and then blasted it out with a palm.
Bang!
Zi Shuhe flew out upside down, drawing a sad arc in the air, and then slammed into a broken courtyard wall behind.
Boom!
Rubbles and bricks rolled down, and smoke filled the air.
Zi Shuhe was lying in the ruins, feeling like all the bones in his body were falling apart, and severe pain hit him like a tide.
